title: Kage: a five-chapter night walk through a Kyoto mountain temple that runs live in the browser
description:
Scroll down, and Kage carries the camera through a rain-soaked night at a Kyoto mountain temple. Three.js builds the torii gates, lanterns, fog, falling leaves, and moon in real time, while generated scene plates and foreground artwork add depth across five chapters. The experience lives in one HTML file with no build step or runtime network dependency. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/MengTo/kage
